chunks: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Razzaz al-Kufi narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'ar, from al-Hasan ibn 'Atiyyah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When you enter the al-Ha'ir, say: O Allah, this is a position by which You honored me and dignified me. O Allah, grant me my desire within it based on the reality of my faith in You and Your messengers.

Peace of Allah be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah. And the peace of His angels upon you, with the pure, pleasant scents that reach you morning and evening. Peace be upon the angels of Allah who are brought near.
And peace be upon those who submit to you with their hearts and speak of your merits with their tongues.

I testify that you are truthful and veracious. You were truthful in what you invited to and truthful in what you brought. And that you are the avenger of Allah on earth, of the blood whose avenger is not found on earth except through your supporters.
O Allah, make me love their sites and their presence until You join me to them and make me a forerunner and follower for them in this world and the Hereafter.
Then walk a short distance and say Allahu Akbar seven times.

Then stand facing the grave and say: Sanctified is He whom the dominion and the kingdom sanctify, and all His creation is hallowed by His names. Sanctified is Allah, the King, the Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
O Allah, register me among Your visitors, to the best of Your places and the best of Your creation.
O Allah, curse the Jibt and the Taghut, and curse their followers and adherents.
O Allah, let me witness all the sites of goodness with the family of Your Prophet.
O Allah, make me die as a Muslim and grant me a sure footing with those who remain, the inheritors who inherit Firdaws, abiding eternally in it, from among Your righteous servants.
Then say Allahu Akbar five times, then walk a short distance and say: O Allah, I believe in You and am certain of Your promise.
O Allah, write for me faith and establish it in my heart. O Allah, make what I say with my tongue its reality in my heart and its law in my actions.
O Allah, make me among those who have a steady footing with al-Husayn (peace be upon him), and establish me among those who were martyred with him.
Then say Allahu Akbar three times, and raise your hands until you place them both on the grave.

Then say: I testify that you are pure, the pure one from the pure one, the pure one. You were purified and the lands were purified through you, and the earth in which you are was purified, and your sanctuary was purified.
I testify that you commanded justice and equity and invited to them, and that you are the avenger of Allah in His land until He extracts for you from all His creation.
Then place both your cheeks on the grave, then sit and remember Allah as you wish, and turn to Allah in whatever you wish to turn.
Then return and place your hands at his feet, then say: May Allah's blessings be upon your soul and your body. You spoke the truth and you are the truthful, verified one.
May Allah kill whoever killed you with hands and tongues.
Then turn to Ali, his son, and say whatever you wish.
Then stand up and face the graves of the martyrs and say: Peace be upon you, O martyrs. You are for us forerunners and we are for you followers.
Rejoice in the promise of Allah which will not be broken. Allah will complete your blood for you, and will take revenge through you on His enemy in the earth.
You are the masters of the martyrs in this world and the Hereafter.
Then place the grave before you, then pray as much as seems good to you.
Then say: I have come to you as a visitor, and I seek intercession through you with Allah for all my needs from the affairs of my world and my Hereafter.
Through you, the intercessors intercede with Allah for their needs, and through you, those who seek revenge attain their request with Allah.
Then say Allahu Akbar eleven consecutive times, and do not hasten in them.
Then walk a short distance, then stand facing the Qibla and say: Praise be to Allah, the One, the Unifier in all affairs.
He created the creation, and nothing of their affairs escaped His knowledge, so He taught it by His power.
The earth and those upon it have guaranteed your blood and your avenger, O son of the Messenger of Allah. May Allah's blessings be upon you.

I testify that you have from Allah that which He promised you of victory and conquest, and that you have from Allah the true promise regarding the destruction of your enemies and the completion of Allah's promise.

I testify that those who followed you are the truthful ones, about whom Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, said: 'Those are the truthful and the witnesses with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light.'
Then say Allahu Akbar seven times, then walk a short distance.
Then face the grave and say: Praise be to Allah who took no son, and had no partner in the dominion.
And created everything and determined it with determination.
I testify that you invited to Allah and to His Messenger, and fulfilled the covenant of Allah for Him, and rose for Allah with His words, and strove in the way of Allah until certainty came to you.
May Allah curse the nation that killed you, and the nation that oppressed you, and the nation that abandoned you, and the nation that deceived you [forsook you].

O Allah, I bear witness to You with the guardianship for those whom You loved and His messengers loved, and I bear witness with disavowal from those from whom You disavowed and His messengers disavowed.

O Allah, curse those who belied Your messengers, destroyed Your Ka'bah, distorted Your Book, and spilled the blood of the family of Your Prophet, and caused corruption in Your land and humiliated Your servants.
O Allah, multiply the punishment upon them [for them] in whatever has passed of Your paths, Your land, and Your sea.
O Allah, curse them in the secrecy of secrets and the manifest public sphere, in Your earth and Your heaven.
And whenever you enter the Ha'ir, say peace, and place your hand [your cheek] on the grave.

key_terms.التِّرَات: Revenge or blood-avenging, specifically the avenging of the blood of the martyrs.
key_terms.الْحَائِر: The specific area or enclosure where the grave of Imam al-Husayn is located.
key_terms.الْمُلْكُ وَ الْمَلَكُوت: The visible and invisible kingdoms, referring to the domains of creation.
key_terms.الْوَلَايَة: Divine guardianship or love, referring to the connection between the Imams and their followers.
key_terms.ثَارُ اللَّهِ: The avenger of Allah, a title referring to the one who avenges the blood of the martyrs.
key_terms.قَدَمُ ثَبَاتٍ: A steady footing or established position, often referring to standing firm in faith or martyrdom.

ai.seo_question: What is the step-by-step ritual for performing the Ziyarah of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This comprehensive ziyarah from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* serves as a foundational text for Shia ritual practice, emphasizing the concept of *thar Allah* (God’s avenger) and the spiritual continuity between the Prophet, the Imams, and the martyrs. The ritual’s structured movements and specific supplications reflect the Shia emphasis on *tawassul* (intercession) and *walayah* (divine guardianship), linking the physical act of visiting the grave to eschatological promises of resurrection and victory over enemies.
